Amazing Cucumber Sushi
By: Matt
Published: Tuesday, November 21, 2017 - 10:57pm

Ingredients




For the sushi
1⁄2 avocado (sliced)
1 cucumber
1⁄2 medium red bell pepper (sliced into long strips)
1⁄2 large yellow bell pepper (sliced into long strips)
For the rice
1⁄3 cup sticky rice

Preparation

1 Put the rice in a saucepan, cover with double the amount of water and simmer until cooked (around 40 minutes). Then allow it to cool. 2 Cut the cucumber in half and hollow out the flesh. Keep it to use in a smoothie later. 3 Insert the rice into the cucumber halves, and compact it to one side, so that there's room for the other ingredients. 4 Insert a slice of avocado and some pepper slices and then more rice to fill any gaps. 5 Slice the cucumber into sushi sized pieces. Be careful not to slice it too thin or the filling will all fall out. 6 Serve it with a little salt and pepper and impress your friends!
